Model calculations

DAX essentials

Know what returns a value, what returns a table, and what changes filter context.

🎯

Core functions

CALCULATE
Changes filter context - think “change the lens.”
FILTER
Returns a filtered table.
SUMX
Iterates row by row, then aggregates. 🪜
RELATED
Brings a column value through an existing relationship.
PATH / PATHITEM
Build a parent-child path and extract hierarchy levels.
RANKX
Ranks rows or items by an expression or measure.
DISTINCTCOUNT
Counts unique values.
COUNTROWS(FILTER(...))
Counts rows that meet a condition.
CALENDAR / CALENDARAUTO
Manual date range versus an automatic date range.
USERELATIONSHIP
Activates an inactive relationship inside a calculation.

🧠 Memory CALCULATE = lens · SUMX = row loop

🧹

Filter override

  • ALL()Remove all filters.
  • ALLEXCEPT()Remove all except named columns.
  • VALUES()Return the unique visible values.

🧠 Memory ALL = wipe · ALLEXCEPT = keep one · VALUES = unique set

⏳

Time intelligence

  • TOTALYTD / TOTALQTD / TOTALMTD - built-in period aggregations.
  • SAMEPERIODLASTYEAR - prior-period comparison.
  • Rolling 12 months - use a window such as DATESINPERIOD; LASTNONBLANK can anchor the last valid period, and DATEADD shifts time.

🧠 Memory LASTNONBLANK = anchor · DATEADD = shift · CALCULATE = lens

🔢

Counting patterns

  • COUNT()Non-blank values in one column.
  • COUNTROWS()Rows in a table; combine with FILTER for conditions.
  • DISTINCTCOUNT()Unique IDs or values.
  • CALCULATE + conditionConditional SUM or AVERAGE.

Prepare the data

Power Query & data preparation

Reduce early, preserve meaning, and keep transformations refresh-friendly.

📜

Where filtering helps

Filter levelEffectBest remembered as
Source (SQL WHERE)Reduces rows before import.Best for large data
Power QueryReduces rows before model load.Keeps the model small
ModelThe full data has already loaded.No size gain
Report / page / visualChanges only what is displayed.Cosmetic filtering

🧠 Memory Shrink the model at Source or Power Query · Report filters change the view only

🗂️

Transform & clean

  • Append stacks rows; Merge joins tables.
  • Group Queries organizes query steps and folders.
  • Filter at the source or in Power Query.
  • Conditional Column provides IF/ELSE logic.
  • Replace Errors fixes error values without dropping valid rows.
  • Replace Values standardizes inconsistent labels.
  • Column Profile helps detect anomalies and outliers.
  • SharePoint Online: use SharePoint Folder, then filter the path.
🔍

Preview & connectors

Column QualityHealth check
Column ProfileDeep scan
Column DistributionFrequency chart

📌 Select Related Tables selects only PK/FK-linked tables.

📦 Dataflows & CDM use Power Query in the cloud and can store data in CDM folders with CSV data and JSON metadata.

🌐 Connectors: Web can scrape HTML; JSON connects to structured JSON data.

🧠 Memory CDM = warehouse · JSON = blueprint

⚡

Query folding

Power Query pushes compatible transformations back to the source, so the source system does more of the work.

  • ✓View Native Query is available: folding is working up to that step.
  • ✓Common folding sources: SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL, and Azure SQL.
  • ×Flat files such as Excel, CSV, and JSON do not fold.
  • !Non-foldable steps, including some index or cross-source merge operations, can stop folding.
  • ◆A greyed-out native query can mean the source or a prior manual step cannot fold.

Incremental refresh uses RangeStart and RangeEnd filters and benefits from folding.

🧠 Memory Folding = outsourcing · Smart sources = yes · Flat files = no

⭐

Model the data

Modeling patterns

Favor a clear star schema, intentional relationships, and calculation-friendly dimensions.

🏗️

Structure & relationships

  • Star schema is generally simpler than snowflake: fact table in the center, dimensions around it.
  • Hide technical IDs from report view when users do not need them.
  • For a many-to-one relationship, remove blanks and duplicates from the “one” side.
  • Role-playing date: reuse one date table with one active relationship and inactive alternatives activated by USERELATIONSHIP.
  • PATH creates hierarchy text; PATHITEM extracts levels that can form a hierarchy.
  • Keep business keys such as ProductID and CustomerID; remove unused audit IDs and GUIDs.

🧠 Memory Active = main road · Inactive = side road

🧩

Calculation & model patterns

Quick measure

For average profit, an iterator pattern such as AVERAGEX can be combined with KEEPFILTERS when preserving filter behavior matters.

RLS relationship

When security must propagate across a relationship, use Both and “Apply security filter in both directions” deliberately; avoid ambiguity.

Compression

Numeric keys generally compress better than text keys.

Month-end inventory

Use CALCULATE with LASTDATE or LASTNONBLANK for the supplied month-end pattern.

Distinct tables

VALUES returns unique values from one column; SUMMARIZE can return unique combinations.

Manage and secure

Power BI Service, security & ALM

Separate creation from distribution, apply security intentionally, and promote trusted content.

🛡️

Security & permissions

  • Assign Microsoft Entra ID groups to RLS roles. A dynamic rule such as [Region] = USERPRINCIPALNAME() works only when the column stores the matching user identity.
  • Sensitivity labels classify and can protect content.
  • Build permission lets users create new reports from a semantic model.
  • Common workspace roles include Viewer, Contributor, Member, and Admin.
  • Data alerts are configured in the Power BI service for supported dashboard tiles such as KPI, Card, and Gauge.
  • Tenant and admin settings can restrict export.
  • App viewing for free users depends on the workspace capacity and licensing configuration.
📦

Optimize the model

Performance tuning

Load less, refresh less, calculate efficiently, and prove where the time is going.

📉

Aggregate data

Summarize daily data to monthly when detail is not required. Fewer rows usually means faster models.

🔄

Incremental refresh

Refresh only new or changed partitions using RangeStart and RangeEnd.

🚀

DirectQuery aggregations

Keep an imported summary table while detailed data remains in DirectQuery.

⏱️

Performance Analyzer

Identify slow visuals and DAX queries before optimizing.

💡

Sample at source

Pull a small representative subset while developing to reduce memory pressure.

🧰

Keep the model lean

Use Top N filters, remove unused columns, optimize DAX, separate fact and dimensions, and schedule refresh off-peak.

🧠 Memory Filter early · Import smart · DAX light · Visuals few

🎯

Final one-line summary

“Fold early, clean smart, model star, secure via Entra ID, measure with CALCULATE, and refresh light.”
